name: Greatwestern Products Co., LLC
old_description: From classic popcorn and cotton candy to delightful snow cones and decadent funnel cakes, our premium products evoke the joy and nostalgia of the county fair. We also offer comprehensive movie theater concessions, complete with all the ingredients and nonfood supplies needed to keep movie-goers snacking.
about:
Great Western Products operates from Hollywood in northeast Alabama, with a packaging hub in the Midwest Corn Belt. The company has been crafting concession foods for over 50 years, tracing its roots to popcorn production before expanding into a full line of fair and theater snacks.

The firm manufactures a range of concession products including popcorn, cotton candy floss sugar, snow cone syrups, popcorn seasonings, funnel cake and corn dog batters, and candy apple mix. It also supplies packaging materials such as cups, tubs, and bags. Operations span a headquarters facility in Alabama and a dedicated packaging hub in the Corn Belt, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Great Western serves fair and carnival operators, movie theater chains, and event concessionaires worldwide. Its customer base includes blockbuster theater chains and snack distributors across Canada, the Caribbean, Asia, Europe, and South America. The company also works with businesses seeking private-label snack lines, offering low minimum order quantities for custom branding.

The company emphasizes its low minimum quantity requirements for private-label programs, backed by long-standing vendor relationships and decades of experience in concession product development. It positions itself as a partner for businesses of all sizes to create branded product lines without large volume commitments.
